display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Camera Fleet — 4× Fixed Overview + 2× PTZ
• Fixed overview: 4× AXIS P3275-LVE (4K/8 MP, varifocal,
day/night, H.264/H.265 Zipstream) — persistent wide-
area coverage, continuity while PTZ cameras zoom / pan
• PTZ detail: 2× AXIS V5925 (1080p@60, 30× optical zoom,
pan ±170° @ 100°/s, ONVIF G/M/S + VISCA over IP) —
assigned per target by the camera coordination service
• RTSP ingestion rtsp://:554/… : 4× 4K30 + 2× 1080p60
• Camera ID + location + calibration metadata
• Local network / offline deployment

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RTSP Stream Ingestion
GStreamer: rtspsrc (latency=200, prefer-tcp, do-retransmission)
• 6× RTSP streams — H.264 main / H.265 main profile
• Establishes RTSP session
• Receives RTP media packets
• Handles RTCP / timing
• Network jitter / packet handling
• Connection monitoring + auto-reconnect

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RTP Depayloader
• Extracts encoded video from RTP packets
• H.264 / H.265 depayloading
• Converts network packets into encoded stream data

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Video Parser
• Validates / parses encoded stream
• Extracts codec information
• Prepares stream for hardware decoding

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hardware Video Decoder
NVIDIA NVDEC v5 — Jetson AGX Orin 64GB
• Converts compressed video → raw frames
• Up to 22× 1080p30 decode headroom (H.264/H.265)
• Handles 4× 4K30 (fixed) + 2× 1080p60 (PTZ) comfortably
• GPU / dedicated hardware acceleration
• Next-gen option: Jetson AGX Thor (DeepStream 8.0)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Queue / Buffering
• Separates processing stages
• Provides independent streaming thread
• Absorbs short processing variations
• Bounded buffering to prevent stale frames

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Caps Negotiation
• Establishes compatible media format
• Resolution / pixel format / framerate
• Ensures downstream elements can process frames

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
nvstreammux
Multi-stream Batching
• batch-size=8, batched-push-timeout=40000
• Combines frames from the 6 cameras
• Maintains camera / source IDs
• Creates inference batches
• Improves GPU utilization
• Synchronization / timeout handling

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pre-processing (nvdspreprocess)
• Resize / crop / letterbox to 640 x 640
• Pixel-format conversion (NV12 -> BGR8)
• process-mode=1 (on-stream), model-engine-file path
• Normalization (net-scale-factor from nvinfer config)
• GPU-accelerated on-stream processing
• Prepares frames for inference

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
nvinfer — YOLO11n (TensorRT FP16)
Primary AI Inference
• Ultralytics YOLO11-nano (2.6 M params / ~5.4 MB)
• Fine-tuned on Drone-vs-Bird + site-specific drone images
• Outputs 2 classes: drone, bird
• FP16 TensorRT 10.3 engine (PyTorch → ONNX → .engine)
• ~3 ms / frame on Jetson AGX Orin 64GB
• 640 x 640 input (small-object tuned)
• Optional INT8 + DLA 0/1 offload to free GPU
• Produces class + confidence + bounding boxes
• Attaches results as DeepStream metadata

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
nvtracker — NvDCF / NvMultiObjectTracker
Multi-object Tracking
config_tracker_NvDCF_perf.yml
• minTrackerConfidence=0.25, maxTargetAge=4 frames
• targetProcessingWidth=16 (small-target tuned)
• Maintains object identity across frames
• Generates persistent track IDs
• Track history feeds drone rule engine
(velocity, hover, jitter, smoothness)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DeepStream Metadata
Structured perception output
• Camera / source ID
• Timestamp
• Object class
• Confidence
• Bounding box
• Track ID
• Frame information

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GStreamer Tee
Splits processed stream into independent branches

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Queue
Isolates visualization branch

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
nvdsosd / Overlay
• Draws bounding boxes
• Track IDs
• Labels / confidence
• Confirmed drone alerts highlighted
with severity colors
• Visual debugging

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local Monitoring Display
• Live / near-live visualization
• Operator inspection
• Useful for debugging and validation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Queue
Isolates recording branch

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Optional Local Recording
• Store selected streams / clips
• Useful for incident investigation
• Triggered by confirmed drone alerts
• Retains pre-alert buffer for evidence

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Drone Verification & Decision Layer
Rule-based confirmation of raw YOLO11n detections
(no separate learned anomaly model)
Suppresses false positives (birds, clouds, insects,
IR artifacts) and raises alerts for confirmed drones
using temporal + kinematic + spatial rules over
DeepStream metadata

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Rule Inputs / Feature Extraction
Per-frame (nvinfer metadata):
• Drone class + confidence
• Bounding box: image position / apparent size
• Camera ID / timestamp
Per-track (nvtracker state):
• Track persistence (frames / seconds seen)
• Trajectory: displacement, velocity, turning rate
• Motion jitter (wingbeat oscillation of birds)
• Hover status (near-zero displacement over window)
• Sky-region / airspace zone membership
Cross-camera (multi-view):
• Same drone observed in ≥2 views, geospatially consistent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Drone Rules (config-driven — drone_rules.yaml)
• Confidence gating — initiate track ≥0.60,
maintain / recover existing track ≥0.35
• Persistence — track must survive ≥12 frames
(~0.4 s @ 30fps) or ≥1.0 s before drone confirmed
• Gap filling — interpolate across ≤5 dropped detections
• Trajectory smoothness — reject mean turning rate
>90°/s over a 6-frame window (birds turn erratically)
• Hover detection — displacement <0.5 m over 2.0 s
• Velocity envelope — apparent speed within
1.5–35 m/s
• Airspace / geofence — above horizon line, restricted
sky zones, no-fly zone breach (from coverage map)
• Cross-camera consensus — escalate on ≥2 cameras
agreeing within 3.0 s
Each rule emits violation flag + severity; rules combine
via AND / OR, scoped per camera / zone / class

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Threshold / Decision Layer
YAML config: drone_rules.yaml (tunable defaults)
• Confirmation: confidence floors per class
(drone ≥0.60 init / ≥0.35 maintain; bird lower)
• Persistence: ≥12 frames / ≥1.0 s, gap ≤5 frames
• Kinematics: speed 1.5–35 m/s, turn rate ≤90°/s,
hover window 2.0 s / 0.5 m
• Spatial: horizon line + geofence polygons
(from coverage_map.yaml)
• Cross-camera: ≥2 agreeing views within 3.0 s
• Debounce / hysteresis, duplicate-event suppression

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Structured Drone Alert
• Event ID / triggering rule ID
• Camera ID(s) / zone(s)
• Timestamp / duration
• Detection type (normal / hover / geofence breach)
• Severity / confidence
• Track ID(s) / estimated trajectory
• Evidence frame / supporting metadata

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Candidate Clip Extraction
Triggered only on rule-confirmed candidates
(rare events, not per-frame)
• Sky-region crop around confirmed track
• Short clip / sampled frames per candidate
• Frame source: TEE / local recording branch
• Async queue, non-blocking to main pipeline

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
vLLM VLM Server (off-box x86 GPU)
Serves Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via vLLM
(OpenAI-compatible endpoint :8000/v1/chat/completions)
• Batch verification of clipped candidates
• Async, non-blocking — never on frame-level path
• Host: NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB (x86 server)
• FP8 / BF16 — fits comfortably, headroom for agent layer
• DeepStream path: candidate-clip extraction → REST / gRPC
• OpenAI-compatible REST + token streaming
• Continuous batching / PagedAttention
• Same server later serves optional AI agent layer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Verification Result
• drone_confirmed yes / no + brief rationale
• Semantic drone-vs-bird disambiguation
• Suppresses remaining false positives
• Feeds threshold / decision layer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Camera Coverage & Calibration Model
coverage_map.yaml — site survey + OpenCV calibration
• Mount locations, orientation, per-camera intrinsics
• FOV geometry + PTZ pan / tilt / zoom ranges
• Overlap zones between the 4 fixed + 2 PTZ cameras
• Blind spots / obstructions / restricted sky zones
• Shared geospatial site-map frame (GPS / grid)
• Manually configured initially, refined after deployment

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Global Track Manager
Associates per-camera (DeepStream) local tracks into
global drone identities (position + appearance gating)
• Maintains fused track state + position uncertainty
(constant-velocity Kalman filter, 3σ covariance)
• Resolves track fragmentation / ID switches
• Keeps cross-camera identity consistent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Predictive Motion Model
Constant-velocity Kalman filter per global track
• Estimates next position / region with 3σ uncertainty
• Predicts time-to-exit from current FOV
• Feeds pre-acquisition of the receiving PTZ camera

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Trackability / Handoff-Risk Estimator
Trigger handoff if predicted time-to-exit < 2.0 s
• FOV-boundary distance, incl. prediction uncertainty
• Target pixel size (min ~15 px to track reliably)
• Camera pan / tilt / zoom state (view changes even
if the drone path does not)
• Occlusion risk (from coverage map)
• Receiving-camera visibility & availability

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Handoff Coordinator
Scored candidate-camera list per handoff event
• Criteria — predicted visibility, image resolution,
time-to-acquire, occlusion risk, availability,
coverage cost of repositioning
• Triggers handoff at predicted FOV exit − 2 s
• Sends target-acquisition request to the receiver
• Verifies receiver detection (~3 frames / 0.5 s)
• Transfers global track only after confirmation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Coverage-Aware Scheduling & Planning
Keeps ≥1 camera observing every protected zone
• Estimates coverage lost when a PTZ camera moves
• Avoids sending the last camera covering a region
• Overlapping-FOV handoff zones
• Predictive PTZ repositioning to the acquisition area
• Competing-target scheduling (2 PTZ, many targets)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PTZ Controller
ONVIF Profile S Move / AXIS VAPIX absolute-move
• Converts target-region requests into pan / tilt / zoom
commands (velocity presets, pan ≤100°/s + dwell)
• Accounts for movement + zoom settling time
• Handles PTZ overshoot / delayed movement
• Reports PTZ state (position / zoom / speed) back
to the coordinator

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Lost-Target Recovery
Re-acquire target within ~1.5 s of loss
• Triggered on detection gaps > maxTargetAge (4 frames)
• Reacquisition sweep ±15° around predicted position
• Re-predict every ~100 ms; re-verify on candidates
• Handles missed detections & failed handoffs
• Coordinates adjacent cameras to reacquire the target

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Event Processor
• Receives confirmed drone alerts
• Validates event schema
• Correlates related events (multi-camera)
• Removes duplicates
• Applies event rules
• Assigns severity / priority

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Configuration Management
YAML / JSON (JetPack 6.1 + DeepStream 7.1 stack)
• camera_fleet.yaml (models, RTSP URLs, calibration)
• config_infer_primary_yolo11n.txt (engine / labels)
• config_tracker_NvDCF_perf.yml
• drone_rules.yaml (rule thresholds)
• coverage_map.yaml (FOV / zones / PTZ ranges)
• VLM model + prompt config (5b)
• Event / alert rules

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Alert / Notification
• Operator console + local UI (over FastAPI / HTTP)
• Publish to MQTT — EMQX broker, DeepStream msgbroker:
topics drone/alerts, drone/events, camera/health
• Webhook / e-mail dispatch (SMTP)
• Per-severity routing (info / warn / critical)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local Event Storage
PostgreSQL 16 (event store) / SQLite (single-edge)
• Camera metadata
• Detection metadata
• Track information
• Drone alert + VLM-verification records
• Handoff / coverage-gap metrics
• System health / logs

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local Backend API
FastAPI + Uvicorn (:8000)
• Query cameras
• Query events
• Query drone-alert history
• Retrieve evidence clips / VLM results
• Camera / worker health
• Configuration interface

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Camera & Pipeline Health
Health checks every 5 s; RTSP auto-reconnect 3 s
• RTSP connection status
• Frames received
• Input FPS
• Dropped frames
• Reconnection attempts
• GStreamer bus errors
• Pipeline state

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Performance Monitoring
NVIDIA DCGM / nvidia-smi + DeepStream stats
• GPU utilization (target <85%)
• GPU memory
• Inference latency (~3 ms YOLO11n FP16, 640×640)
• End-to-end latency (target <500 ms)
• Inference FPS per stream
• Batch formation (batch-size=8)
• Queue depth / dropped frames (<1%)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Structured Logging
• Application logs
• GStreamer errors / warnings
• Camera failures
• Inference failures
• Anomaly processing
• System events

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Distributed DeepStream Workers
• Cameras partitioned across workers (e.g. Jetson AGX
Orin / AGX Thor nodes, few cameras each)
• Multiple NVIDIA GPUs
• Independent worker processes
• Horizontal scaling

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Message Bus
MQTT (EMQX, edge) → Apache Kafka (scale-out)
• Decouples inference from backend
• Event streaming
• Independent consumers
• Supports distributed deployment

• Natural-language investigation

• Explain anomalies
• Retrieve relevant evidence
• Operator assistance
Not part of frame-level inference
